title: oEmbed 1.0 provider response
description: JSON response of an oEmbed provider. Source: https://oembed.com. The $defs/consumerRequest entry describes the query parameters of the consumer request.

version.description: The oEmbed version number. MUST be "1.0".

title.description: A text title, describing the resource.

author_name.description: The name of the author/owner of the resource.

author_url.description: A URL for the author/owner of the resource.

provider_name.description: The name of the resource provider.

provider_url.description: The URL of the resource provider.

cache_age.description: The suggested cache lifetime for this resource, in seconds.

thumbnail_url.description: A URL to a thumbnail image representing the resource.

url.description: The source URL of the image. Only HTTP and HTTPS URLs are valid.

width.description: The width in pixels of the image.

height.description: The height in pixels of the image.

html.description: The HTML required to embed the resource. SHOULD have no padding or margins.

width.description: The width in pixels required to display the HTML.

height.description: The height in pixels required to display the HTML.

consumerRequest.title: oEmbed consumer request query parameters
consumerRequest.description: Query parameters of the HTTP GET request sent to the API endpoint. Values MUST be URL-encoded.

url.description: The URL to retrieve embedding information for.

maxwidth.description: The maximum width of the embedded resource.

maxheight.description: The maximum height of the embedded resource.
